title.en: Chapter 5: Top of the World, Ma

summary.en: The opening mission. {p:Lucia} begins the story inside {l:Hamlet Correctional}, and a flashback shows the job that put her there.

unlock.en: Starts automatically with a new game.

text.en: Talk to your cellmates in {l:Hamlet Correctional}.
Follow the guard to the counselor's office.
In the flashback, rob the {l:Payday Loan} store.
Run from the police.
Go back to the coffee shop, where {p:Lucia} is arrested.

tips.en: You cannot escape the police chase. The arrest is part of the story, so do not worry about getting away.

summary.en: {p:Jason} and {p:Cal} follow a plane by boat to collect its drop, then go looking for {p:Donnie} in the swamps.

missableNote.en: The cash in the trailer can only be picked up during this mission.

unlock.en: Starts right after the {i:Prologue}.

text.en: Follow {p:Donnie}'s plane by boat and collect the packages it drops.
Watch the deal at the swamp docks.
Search the Kingfishers camp in {l:Pelican Valley} for {p:Donnie}.
Get into the shack and untie {p:Donnie}.
Reach the seaplane and fly to {l:Brian's Marina}.
Drive {p:Cal} home.
Go to {p:Jason}'s house in {l:Key Lento}.
Grab the cash from the trailer on your way to the plane. It raises your Professional reputation.

tips.en: You can clear the camp quietly or go in shooting. Both approaches work.

summary.en: {p:Jason} goes shopping for a long gun at {l:Ammu-Nation} and gets to use it sooner than planned.

unlock.en: Complete {i:Gone Fishing}.

text.en: Go to the {l:Ammu-Nation} near {p:Jason}'s house.
Buy a long gun from {p:Andrew}, the clerk.
Survive the Kingfishers ambush outside the store.

tips.en: {i:Gear Up}, {i:Lab Fees}, {i:Just a Scratch} and {i:Unwanted Attention} all open together and can be played in any order.
Going down in the ambush still ends the mission, with no lasting penalty.

unlocks.en: A long gun of your choice: shotgun or tactical rifle

summary.en: A quick stop at {l:Coastal Auto Care} to get {p:Jason}'s car repaired and resprayed for free.

missableNote.en: Upgrades you buy for the Ganado are lost when the car is replaced later in Chapter 1.

unlock.en: Complete {i:Gone Fishing}.

text.en: Drive the {i:Ganado} to {l:Coastal Auto Care}.
Talk to {p:Joey} and pull into the garage.
Pick the free full engine repair.
Choose a respray color.

tips.en: Hold off on paid upgrades for the {i:Ganado}. The car is replaced later in Chapter 1.
You cannot register a different personal vehicle until Chapter 2.

unlocks.en: Free engine repair and respray for Jason's car

summary.en: {p:Brian} sends {p:Jason} to a shop in {l:Key Lento} to fetch something from the lab in the back.

unlock.en: Complete {i:Gone Fishing}, then call {p:Brian} outside the locked shop.

text.en: Call {p:Brian} outside the locked shop in {l:Key Lento}.
Talk to the store clerk.
Go into the back lab and collect the {i:acid}.
Call {p:Brian} again.
Stash the {i:acid} in {l:Brian's lockup}.
Empty the store's cash register.

tips.en: Keypad codes: 0420 for the lab and 7700 for {l:Brian's lockup}.
The $600 is not paid on the spot. It turns up later in the mailbox outside {p:Jason}'s house, because he has no bank account yet.

summary.en: {p:Cal} points {p:Jason} to a car sitting in a police impound, and the job is to drive it out.

unlock.en: Complete {i:Gone Fishing}.

text.en: Meet {p:Cal} on the beach in north {l:Key Lento}.
Drive to the police impound in {l:Hamlet}.
Find the {i:Phoenix} and unhook it from the tow truck.
Lose the police.
Get the car resprayed at the {l:Pay 'n' Spray}.
Deliver the car to {l:Brian's garage} and collect the cash.
Change your hat, glasses or outfit to lower your recognition.
Scan vehicles with the {i:WAiNK} app. Scans count toward the 100% checklist.

tips.en: You are always spotted at the impound gate, so do not waste time trying to slip past it.
Knocking out guards alerts the police.

summary.en: {p:Jason} calls on {p:Mandy} and ends up fixing her kitchen sink.

missableNote.en: The Macizo Cigar box thrown into the street has to be picked up before you leave the area.

unlock.en: Complete {i:Gear Up}, {i:Lab Fees}, {i:Just a Scratch} and {i:Unwanted Attention}.

text.en: Meet {p:Mandy} outside her house.
Follow {p:Mandy} inside.
Get the {i:plunger} from the bathroom.
Fix the kitchen sink with the {i:plunger} and the {i:wrench}.
Pick up the {i:Macizo Cigar} box from the street as you leave.

unlocks.en: Macizo Cigar, if you pick it up

summary.en: A quick errand for {p:Shirley} in {l:Key Lento}: she wants a bottle of rum.

missableNote.en: Only available in Chapter 1. It is gone for good once Tourist Trap starts.

unlock.en: {p:Shirley} calls out to {p:Jason} once {i:Gear Up}, {i:Lab Fees}, {i:Just a Scratch} and {i:Unwanted Attention} are done.

text.en: Talk to {p:Shirley} when she calls out to {p:Jason}.
Go to the marked store.
Ask the clerk for the {i:rum}.

unlocks.en: Boost to the Professional criminal rating

summary.en: {p:Shirley} has one more favor to ask, and this one involves a neighbor's scooter.

missableNote.en: Only available in Chapter 1. It is gone for good once Tourist Trap starts.

unlock.en: Complete {i:Get Shirley's Rum}.

text.en: Go to the neighbor's property.
Take {p:Peggy}'s {i:scooter} from her driveway.
Ride it back to {p:Shirley}.
Park the {i:scooter} inside {p:Shirley}'s house.

summary.en: {p:Brian} wants {p:Arnold} found, so {p:Jason} and {p:Cal} go after him. The chase ends with a choice.

missableNote.en: The choice to kill or spare Arnold cannot be changed later. The main story plays out the same either way.

unlock.en: {p:Brian} calls a few minutes after {i:Pipework}.

text.en: Meet {p:Brian} at the pool bar in south {l:Key Lento}.
Drive {p:Brian}'s truck to the liquor store and pick up {p:Cal}.
Find {p:Arnold} near the radar station on {l:Maroon Key}.
Chase {p:Arnold}'s car while bikers attack you.
Chase him on foot to the docks.
Decide whether to kill {p:Arnold} or let him go.
Try the stunt jumps on the bridge along the chase route. They stay marked on the map afterwards.

summary.en: {p:Jason} takes a job with {p:Kenton} at the {l:Island Dreams} dive shop, leading a bachelor party down to a shipwreck.

unlock.en: Complete {i:Hey Arnold!}.

text.en: Meet {p:Kenton} at the {l:Island Dreams} dive shop.
Take the boat out to the dive spot.
Put on the scuba gear and dive.
Lead the bachelor party through the trench to the shipwreck.
Find three treasures with the {i:metal detector}.
Lift the grate to free {p:Dobbs}.
Deal with the shark and swim the group back to the boat.
Hit the shark twice with the harpoon to save {p:Dobbs}. It only changes the final scene.
Study the fish while you dive. They count toward the animal checklist.

summary.en: A quiet evening at home: {p:Jason} and {p:Cal} rearrange the living room and play a couple of arcade games.

unlock.en: A text arrives after {i:Island Dreams}. Enter {p:Jason}'s house to begin.

text.en: Enter {p:Jason}'s house.
Sit on the couch with {p:Cal}.
Help move the TV, coffee table, couch and chair.
Play {i:Tenebrae Lux}.
Play {i:Street Trash III}.

tips.en: Neither arcade game can be won, so do not worry about the score.
Five optional errands for {p:Lucia}'s return open after this mission. Do them before {i:Coming Home}.

summary.en: One of five optional errands before {p:Lucia} comes home: stock the house with groceries.

unlock.en: Complete {i:Feng Shui}.

text.en: Go to the marked store in {l:Key Lento}.
Pick up any three of the marked items.
Put the groceries in the car trunk and drive to {p:Jason}'s house.
Carry the groceries inside.

tips.en: Finish all five errands before {i:Coming Home} and your relationship with {p:Lucia} starts at 3 of 4.

summary.en: One of five optional errands before {p:Lucia} comes home: pick out flowers for her.

unlock.en: Complete {i:Feng Shui}.

text.en: Go to the flower stand in south {l:Key Lento}.
Talk to the merchant.
Buy either the large bouquet or the roses.

tips.en: Finish all five errands before {i:Coming Home} and your relationship with {p:Lucia} starts at 3 of 4.

summary.en: One of five optional errands before {p:Lucia} comes home: buy her a necklace at {l:The Siren's Chest}.

unlock.en: Complete {i:Feng Shui}.

text.en: Make sure you are carrying enough cash for the purchase.
Go to {l:The Siren's Chest} jewelry store in south {l:Key Lento}.
Buy the {i:necklace}.

tips.en: Finish all five errands before {i:Coming Home} and your relationship with {p:Lucia} starts at 3 of 4.

unlocks.en: Necklace, useful as collateral in a Chapter 2 mission

summary.en: One of five optional errands before {p:Lucia} comes home: get {p:Jason} a haircut.

unlock.en: Complete {i:Feng Shui}.

text.en: Go to the {l:Barnacle Beauties} salon next to the jewelry store.
Talk to the clerk.
Pay for any haircut.

tips.en: Finish all five errands before {i:Coming Home} and your relationship with {p:Lucia} starts at 3 of 4.

summary.en: One of five optional errands before {p:Lucia} comes home: collect her clothes from {p:Andy}.

unlock.en: Complete {i:Feng Shui}.

text.en: Find {p:Andy} at the bar in north {l:Key Lento}.
Follow {p:Andy} to her car.
Take {p:Lucia}'s clothes and put them in your car trunk.

tips.en: Finish all five errands before {i:Coming Home} and your relationship with {p:Lucia} starts at 3 of 4.
Leave the clothes in the trunk until you pick {p:Lucia} up, so she can change at the bar in {i:Coming Home}.

unlocks.en: Lucia changes outfit at the bar in Coming Home

summary.en: {p:Cal} texts {p:Jason} a fishing challenge to take on in {l:Gambit Bay}.

unlock.en: {p:Cal} texts a fishing challenge after {i:Feng Shui}.

text.en: Accept {p:Cal}'s challenge.
Get a boat.
Anchor at the marked spot in {l:Gambit Bay}.
Catch a stoplight parrotfish that weighs more than 2 lbs.
Send the catch to {p:Cal}.

tips.en: There is no rush. {p:Cal}'s fishing pauses at the end of Chapter 1 and comes back later.

summary.en: {p:Lucia} is released. {p:Jason} picks her up, and the welcome-home night at the {l:Rusty Anchor} gets rowdy.

missableNote.en: The errands and house repairs set your starting relationship level with Lucia and are shown during this mission. Finish them before you pick her up.

unlock.en: {p:Lucia} calls the morning after {i:Feng Shui}. Sleep at the house if the call does not come.

text.en: Wait for {p:Lucia}'s call.
Pick up {p:Lucia} at {l:Hamlet Correctional}.
Drive to the {l:Rusty Anchor} and buy two beers.
Hang out with friends and dance with {p:Lucia}.
Find {p:Mattia} and play pool.
Fight {p:D-Man} and his group.
Escape the police with {p:Lucia} and head home.
Finish the five errands first: groceries, flowers, necklace, haircut and {p:Lucia}'s clothes.
Repair {p:Jason}'s house: the bedroom wall, stairs, roof and balcony railing.
Keep {p:Lucia}'s clothes in the car trunk so she can change at the bar.

tips.en: Doing all five errands starts the relationship at 3 of 4.
The pool game, {p:Cal}'s dating app and {p:Donnie}'s offer have no consequences, so choose freely.

summary.en: {p:Jason} opens a bank account at {l:Fleeca} and sets up the {i:BuckMe} app.

unlock.en: {p:Lucia} calls about half a day after {i:Coming Home}.

text.en: Go to the {l:Fleeca} bank in {l:Key Lento}.
Ask the teller about opening an account.
Speak with the bank manager.
Open the {i:BuckMe} app on your phone.
Move $100 from checking into Family Savings.

tips.en: Money in Family Savings can never be withdrawn, but it cannot be lost either.
This mission and {i:Clean Up After Donnie} are both needed to open {i:Down to Earth}. Play them in either order.

summary.en: One of {p:Donnie}'s packages has gone astray in the swamps near {l:Hamlet}, and {p:Jason} goes to get it back.

unlock.en: {p:Donnie} calls the morning after {i:Coming Home}.

text.en: Search the marked swamp area southwest of {l:Hamlet} for the package.
Inspect the opened package.
Take the boat to the shack downriver.
Clear out the three Kingfishers and take the {i:cocaine}.
Deliver the {i:cocaine} to {l:Donnie's trailer} in {l:Key Lento}.

tips.en: The $600 is not paid on the spot. It arrives later in {p:Jason}'s mailbox.

summary.en: {p:Brian} puts {p:Jason} to work at the marina, then sends him and {p:Lucia} out in the seaplane on a delivery run.

unlock.en: Complete both {i:Clean Up After Donnie} and {i:Buck Me}.

text.en: Meet {p:Brian} at {l:Brian's Marina} and follow him to the boat.
Pressure-wash the boat.
Fly the seaplane with {p:Lucia} to {l:Bobcat Bay} and land beside the waiting boat.
Deal with the smugglers.
Land at the three drop spots.
Fly home and land near the dock.
Hide the drugs in the washing machine under the house.
Support {p:Lucia} in front of her parole officer.
Shoot the smugglers in the arms or legs to keep them alive. That earns Professional reputation instead of Violent.

tips.en: {i:Clear Skies} and {i:Day Release} both open after this mission, and both are needed for {i:Swamped}.

unlocks.en: First of 18 meditation spots, on Jason's terrace

summary.en: A calm morning at home: {p:Lucia} invites {p:Jason} to meditate with her on the balcony.

missableNote.en: Offered only at this point in Chapter 1. The balcony meditation is not available after the chapter ends.

unlock.en: Talk to {p:Lucia} in the kitchen the morning after {i:Down to Earth}.

text.en: Talk to {p:Lucia} in the kitchen.
Follow {p:Lucia} to the balcony.
Accept the meditation.

summary.en: A short banking task: pay the cash {p:Jason} is carrying into his account at an ATM.

unlock.en: Complete {i:Buck Me}.

text.en: Select the mission from the mission list on the map.
Use ATM Finder in the {i:BuckMe} app to mark an ATM.
Deposit your pocket cash at the ATM.

tips.en: This mission has no map marker. Start it from the mission list on the map.

summary.en: A long-running savings goal: keep moving money into Family Savings to reach each new tier.

unlock.en: Complete {i:Buck Me}. Later goals open as the story moves on.

text.en: Select the mission from the mission list on the map.
Move money from checking into Family Savings in the {i:BuckMe} app.
Reach $5,000 saved to clear the first tier.
Keep hitting the later savings goals as the story unlocks them.

tips.en: Get at least $5,000 into Family Savings before the end of Chapter 1, because the cash you carry is lost.
Money in Family Savings can never be withdrawn, but it cannot be lost either.

summary.en: A phone call sends {p:Jason} around {l:Mariana County} to search four spots for missing bags.

unlock.en: A phone call from {p:Donnie} or {p:Brian} comes in after {i:Down to Earth}.

text.en: Search the {l:Recreation Area}.
Search the {l:Burned Houses}.
Search {l:Pelican Valley}.
Search {l:Thorpe Adventures}.
Drop the bags at {l:Donnie's trailer}.

tips.en: There is no direct payout for this one. Drugs you recover can be sold to a fence.

summary.en: {p:Jason} flies escort for one of {p:Donnie}'s deals, and the handover does not go smoothly.

unlock.en: {p:Brian} calls after {i:Down to Earth}.

text.en: Meet {p:Brian} at the tiki bar in {l:Southwind}.
Take off in the seaplane and fly to the intercept point.
Fly directly above the other plane and escort it to the swamp airstrip.
Land at the northwest airstrip and watch {p:Donnie}'s deal.
Fight the Final Chapter bikers and free {p:Donnie}.
Hold off the attackers while {p:Donnie} gets to the seaplane.
Ride a bike to the meeting point east of {l:Watson Bay} and board the plane.
Scan the bikers' motorcycles with the {i:WAiNK} app.

summary.en: {p:Jason} and {p:Lucia} put a coffee table together at home.

unlock.en: Starts automatically at the end of {i:Clear Skies}.

text.en: Help {p:Lucia} screw the coffee table together.
Unscrew it when the parts turn out to be in the wrong order.
Take the glass top out of the box and set it on the table.

summary.en: A day out with {p:Kat} and {p:Mattia} that runs from a yacht party to a night at a club.

unlock.en: A call or text arrives after {i:Down to Earth}. Order a drink at the {l:Rusty Anchor} to begin.

text.en: Order a drink at the {l:Rusty Anchor} to meet {p:Kat} and {p:Mattia}.
Take the speedboat out to the yacht.
Race {p:Mattia} on jet skis.
Shoot the champagne bottles.
Find {p:Mattia} on the yacht's lower deck.
Follow {p:Mattia} by car to the {l:Huxley Motel}.
Party at the {l:Nine1Nine} club and dance with {p:Jason}.
Find {p:Jason} and escape by jumping into the pool.
Hit all three champagne bottles.
Have {p:Lucia} ride with {p:Jason} on the jet ski for a relationship boost.
Hold hands at the club and during the pool jump for relationship boosts.

tips.en: You start as {p:Jason} and play the later parts as {p:Lucia}.
The race result and the dress choice do not change anything.

summary.en: {p:Lucia} asks {p:Jason} for a ride home from the {l:Key Lento Community Center}.

missableNote.en: The mission fails if Lucia is not picked up before 4pm.

unlock.en: After {i:Day Release}, {p:Lucia} may call and ask to be picked up.

text.en: Accept {p:Lucia}'s call.
Reach the {l:Key Lento Community Center} before 4pm.
Drive {p:Lucia} home.

summary.en: {p:Cal} invites {p:Jason} for a drink at the {l:Rusty Anchor} and needs a ride home afterwards.

missableNote.en: Only offered in Chapter 1, right after Day Release. The two clothing rewards cannot be bought later.

unlock.en: {p:Cal} texts after {i:Day Release}, before you meet {p:Brian} for {i:Swamped}.

text.en: Answer {p:Cal}'s text.
Have a drink with {p:Cal} at the {l:Rusty Anchor}.
Agree to give him a ride home.
Get {p:Cal} to the car.
Drive {p:Cal} home.

tips.en: Do not refuse the ride twice or walk away. Either one ends the mission with no reward.

summary.en: {p:Brian} takes {p:Jason} deep into the swamps, and the trip turns dangerous fast.

unlock.en: Complete {i:Day Release}, {i:Clear Skies} and {i:Building a Life}.

text.en: Meet {p:Brian} in the back room of {l:Brian's Marina}.
Drive with {p:Brian} to the Kingfishers camp in northwest {l:Mariana County}.
Inspect the pig pen.
Fight off the ambush and follow {p:Brian}.
Board the helicopter and cover {p:Lori}.
Chase {p:Lori}'s boat and jump aboard.
Win the struggle to rescue {p:Lori}.
Back home, tell {p:Lucia} about {p:Brian}'s retirement for a relationship boost.

tips.en: The jump only triggers when you are very close to {p:Lori}'s boat, so pull right up beside it.

summary.en: {p:Jason} is sent to {l:Donnie's trailer} to tie up some loose ends.

missableNote.en: Donnie's H&L .38, a unique revolver in the car trunk, is lost for good if you destroy the car before taking it.

unlock.en: Starts automatically right after {i:Swamped}.

text.en: Take {p:Donnie}'s bag from the bed in his trailer.
Pack his belongings.
Get past the three Aviators outside, either by fighting or by running.
Drive {p:Donnie}'s car north out of {l:Key Lento}.
Open the trunk and take {i:Donnie's H&L .38}.
Destroy the car by burning it or sinking it.
Use the drugs you find while packing. They cost health but give a brief stamina boost.

tips.en: Things to pack: the photo, flight schedule, clothes, ID, phone message and map.

unlocks.en: Donnie's H&L .38, if taken from the trunk

summary.en: A sunken boat off the north coast of {l:Key Lento} still holds a bag worth recovering.

unlock.en: Complete {i:Swamped}.

text.en: Take a boat to the search area off north {l:Key Lento}.
Dive in the southeast part of the area to find the sunken boat.
Open the rear compartment and take the bag.
Sell the bag at {l:Brian's lockup}.

tips.en: The $1,200 comes from selling the bag to {p:Brian}.
Do this before {i:Recalibration}. From that mission until Chapter 2 there is no free roam.

summary.en: A slow day with {p:Lucia} and {p:Cal}: a few beers, some fishing and a cookout.

missableNote.en: Last safe point of Chapter 1. From here until Chapter 2 there is no free roam, the cash you carry and Jason's Key Lento house are lost, and Jason is not playable for a long time.

unlock.en: {p:Lucia} calls during or after {i:Don Gone} and {i:Donnie's Lost Drugs}. Return home to begin.

text.en: Return home to {p:Lucia}.
Buy a six-pack at the marked liquor store.
Drive to {p:Cal}'s house and talk to him behind the house.
Take the boat to the fishing spot and catch some fish.
Return to {p:Cal}'s dock and grill three fish.
Follow {p:Lucia} to the front yard and drive her home.

tips.en: Make a separate manual save before you start.
Put at least $5,000 into Family Savings first. Savings are safe; the cash you carry is not.
Finish {i:Get Shirley's Rum} and {i:Steal the Scooter} first if you want them. They disappear for good at {i:Tourist Trap}.

summary.en: {p:Jason} and {p:Lucia} take on a pickup job in southern {l:Key Lento}.

missableNote.en: Point of no return for Chapter 1. Get Shirley's Rum and Steal the Scooter disappear for good, and pocket cash and the Key Lento house are lost. Kenton's dives, Cal's fishing and the Kingfishers hideouts pause and return later.

unlock.en: Starts automatically after {i:Recalibration}.

text.en: Take the bag from the locker in the {l:Visitor Center}.
Go back to the car.
Follow the cop.
Pick up the bag.
As {p:Lucia}, protect {p:Jason} and carry him to the boat.
Escape to open water by boat.
Go to {p:Cal}'s house.

tips.en: You start as {p:Jason} and switch to {p:Lucia} partway through.
Killing police in this mission does not change your criminal profile.

summary.en: {p:Lucia} has to get out of {l:Key Lento} with the police closing in.

unlock.en: Starts automatically after {i:Tourist Trap}.

text.en: Fight off the two robbers in {p:Jason}'s house.
Leave through the front door before the house explodes.
Stay low and move through the police search area.
Reach the main road and steal a car, or keep going on foot.
Get out of the search zone.

tips.en: Do not go for {p:Jason}'s cash stash. It cannot be reached in time.

summary.en: The chapter closes with a visit to {l:Vice City Hospital} that does not stay peaceful.

unlock.en: Starts automatically after {i:Home Sweet Home}.

text.en: As {p:Lucia}, go to the second floor of {l:Vice City Hospital} and find {p:Jason} in room 203.
As {p:Jason}, shoot the attackers from the wheelchair.
Take the shotgun and hold off the reinforcements.
Crawl to the gun after the explosion.
Defend the ambulance from the police chasing it.

tips.en: This is the final mission of Chapter 1. It runs straight into the first Chapter 2 mission, {i:What's in the Bag?}.

summary.en: {p:Lucia} goes through the bag in the motel room and takes a closer look at what is inside.

unlock.en: Starts automatically after the last Chapter 1 mission, {i:Discharge Time}.

text.en: Open the {i:bag} in your room at the {l:Starlet Motel}.
Flip the {i:statue} over and read the {i:note} under its base.
Examine the {i:hard drive}. It cannot be read yet.

summary.en: {p:Lucia} chases down a stolen ambulance near the motel and destroys it.

unlock.en: The marker appears the first time {p:Lucia} leaves the motel room after {i:What's in the Bag?}.

text.en: Head to the barn east of the {l:Starlet Motel} and go in by the stairs at the back.
Get on the {i:ATV} and chase the stolen ambulance.
Stay on the {i:ATV} until the ambulance crashes into a tree.
Grab the {i:gas can} behind the ambulance and pour fuel over the vehicle.
Light the fuel, or shoot the can, to destroy the ambulance.
Get away before the police show up.

summary.en: A quick supply run to the store across the road from the motel.

unlock.en: Appears on the map after {i:What's in the Bag?}.

text.en: Walk to the {l:Alpha} store across the road from the motel.
Pick up the eight marked items: soda, protein bars, fruit, soup, gauze, bandanas, hair clippers and a makeup bag.
Bring the supplies back to the motel room.

tips.en: You pay for each item as you take it, so you do not need to speak to the clerk.

unlocks.en: Relationship boost between Jason and Lucia

summary.en: {p:Lucia} goes looking for painkillers for {p:Jason} and ends up chasing a supplier around {l:Port Gellhorn}.

unlock.en: Opens after {i:Just Moved In} and the motel manager's objective {i:Overnight Charges}.

text.en: Ask around the motel until {p:Zach} points you to {p:Vicki} in Room 10.
Pay {p:Vicki} $50 for pills and bring them to {p:Jason}.
Go back and confront {p:Vicki} once the pills prove to be the wrong kind.
Drive {p:Vicki} to {l:Delights} in {l:Port Gellhorn} and wait while she picks up her pay.
Search for {p:Dunk}: first his trailer, then the boatyard, then the car wash.
Handle the {p:Kolts} gang at the car wash.
Chase {p:Dunk}'s car until it crashes at a farm.
Drive {p:Dunk} back to his trailer.
Choose Defuse twice at the car wash to avoid a fight and earn Professional reputation.

summary.en: {p:Lucia} visits {p:Moses} at his garage and learns how to steal, respray and register a car.

unlock.en: Complete {i:Girls' Trip}.

text.en: Drive a car into {p:Moses}'s garage in {l:Port Gellhorn}.
Follow him into the yard and scan the parked cars with the {i:WAiNK app}.
Pick up the {i:Slim Jim}.
Open the {i:Montagne XL} with the {i:Slim Jim}.
If your car has a tracker, steal one without a tracker in town and bring it back.
Respray the car and register it in {p:Lucia}'s name.

tips.en: {p:Moses} will not accept cars stolen close to his garage.

unlocks.en: Sell untracked stolen cars to Moses

summary.en: {p:Moses} wants one particular car. Find it, take it and deliver it in good shape.

unlock.en: After the {i:Moses} mission, he texts you a photo of the target car.

text.en: Go to the search area near the old {l:Traders' Union building}.
Look for the white {i:'82 Canis Crawler}.
Fight the guards or sneak past them, then take the car.
Bring the car to {p:Moses}'s garage with as little damage as possible.
Deliver the car in good condition for a $500 bonus.

unlocks.en: Port Gellhorn Garage, given by Moses soon after
Vice City Real Estate app for buying garages

summary.en: {p:Lucia} helps {p:Dunk} with a meeting that goes bad and ends in a fight at an airstrip.

unlock.en: {p:Dunk} phones twice once the other open Chapter 2 objectives are done.

text.en: Meet {p:Dunk} at his trailer and wait with him behind the dumpster.
Force {p:Dr. Bill} into the car.
Drive to the docks and enter the {p:Kolts}' compound.
Get out when the meeting goes bad and lose the {p:Kolts}.
Pick {p:Dr. Bill} up again after he jumps out of the car.
Drive to the airstrip south-west of {l:Port Gellhorn}.
Clear out the attackers and find {p:Dunk} in the main building.
Drive {p:Dunk} home.
Take the optional loot from {p:Dr. Bill}, worth about $1,000.

tips.en: The $1,700 arrives through {i:BuckMe} on the next in-game day.
The airstrip fight is one of the harder ones in this chapter.

unlocks.en: Two robbery locations appear on the map the next day

summary.en: {p:Jason} is back in action, and the pair rob three small businesses in a row.

unlock.en: After {i:Slam Dunk}, wait about half an in-game day for {p:Jason}'s call, then return to the motel.

text.en: Go back to the {l:Starlet Motel} when {p:Jason} calls.
Drive to {l:Hank's Waffles}.
Rob the diner: aim at the staff and empty the register before the timer runs out.
Rob the liquor store.
Rob the thrift store.
Get back in the car and lose the two-star wanted level.

tips.en: You get one minute for each of the three robberies.

summary.en: A short walk to the motel kitchen that opens up switching between the two characters.

unlock.en: Starts right after {i:Breakfast Run}.

text.en: Walk with {p:Lucia} to the motel kitchen.
Listen to {p:Wyman} talk about the mud club.
Buy {p:Lucia} a $2 coffee from the machine.
Return to the car and open the partner menu.

unlocks.en: Free switching between Jason and Lucia
Follow-up jobs: Thrillbillies, Hit Avery Pawn, Hit Kingpin Bowling, Impounded Vehicle

summary.en: An optional dirt bike race at the {l:Thrillbilly Mud Club}.

unlock.en: Marked on the map after {i:Coffee Break}, where {p:Wyman} mentions the races.

text.en: Go to the {l:Thrillbilly Mud Club}.
Buy an outfit for each character at the merch stall by the entrance.
Watch {p:Billy} and his crew arrive.
Rent a {i:Manchez} or a {i:Sanchez} at {l:Roostere's Rentals}.
Speak to the race organizer at the start line.
Finish the 14-rider race anywhere but last.
Place higher for more prize money, up to $2,500 for first.

unlocks.en: Billy later texts with the job Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab

summary.en: An optional job with {p:Billy}'s crew: run down an armored truck on dirt bikes and blow it open.

unlock.en: A few in-game hours after {i:Thrillbillies}, {p:Billy} sends a message.

text.en: Use the bench at the marker in {l:Port Gellhorn} to meet {p:Billy}.
Get on the {i:Highwayman Sanchez} and follow him.
Chase the armored truck with the crew until it crashes.
Plant a charge on the rear doors and set it off.
Knock out the guard, or leave him alone.
Take the bag and follow {p:Billy} up the hill to regroup.

tips.en: Store the dirt bike in a garage afterwards if you want to keep it.

unlocks.en: Keep the dirt bike by storing it in a garage

summary.en: An optional hunting trip for {p:Jason} with {p:Bret Vogel} in the far north.

unlock.en: After {i:Coffee Break}, {p:Bret} texts {p:Jason}, who has to go without {p:Lucia}.

text.en: As {p:Jason}, meet {p:Bret Vogel} at his cabin and drive his truck to the woods.
Track the deer by following its trail.
Study the deer through a scope or binoculars.
Bring it down with a single clean shot.
Load the carcass onto the truck.
Drive back and carry the deer into the processing area.
Use one heart or head shot to keep the carcass in top condition.

tips.en: {p:Jason} has to go alone, so leave {p:Lucia} behind.

summary.en: {p:Vicki} has a plan to rob her boss at {l:Delights}, and {p:Jason} and {p:Lucia} carry it out.

unlock.en: {p:Vicki} calls with the plan some time after {i:Coffee Break}, once the other open main objectives are cleared.

text.en: Go to {l:Delights}. {p:Lucia} walks in through the front.
As {p:Jason}, climb the fence behind the club to get backstage.
Decide whether {p:Jason} joins the stage act.
Open the safe in the office.
Shoot your way out of the club and lose the bikers.
If {p:Jason} danced, buy him new clothes.
Meet {p:Vicki} and hand over the cash.
Joining the stage act adds scenes and a clothes-shopping step, while refusing is shorter. The payout is the same either way.

tips.en: The code for the office safe is 2008.
The $10,000 arrives through {i:BuckMe} on the next in-game day.

summary.en: The stay at the motel comes to a violent end, and {p:Jason} and {p:Lucia} have to fight their way out.

missableNote.en: This is the point of no return for Chapter 2: the motel stops being your home. Two collectible cards inside the motel cannot be reached afterwards.

unlock.en: Finish every other Chapter 2 main objective and save at least $15,000; your partner then calls about an article from {p:Cal}.

text.en: Go to the motel room and use the bathroom door.
As {p:Jason}, fight off the attackers and get to the motel cafe.
As {p:Lucia}, hold the attackers back.
Take a biker's motorcycle and follow {p:Jason}'s car.
Ride up beside the car and jump onto it.
Shoot at the police chasing you until you escape.

tips.en: Before you start, collect the two cards inside the motel, bank your cash and make a manual save.
If {p:Jason}'s marker disappears after you die on the motorcycle ride, restart the mission to bring it back.

summary.en: {p:Jason} and {p:Lucia} arrive in {l:Vice City}, visit a club in {l:Crosstown} and settle into a new apartment.

unlock.en: Starts automatically after {i:Checking Out}.

text.en: Drive to the {l:Jack of Hearts} club in {l:Crosstown}.
Walk around to the other entrance and follow {p:Dre'Quan} inside.
Throw money at the dancers, or turn the cash down.
Follow {p:Dre'Quan} upstairs to meet {p:Boobie Ike}.
Drive to {l:Bayside Apartments} and park.
Walk up to the apartment on the second floor.

unlocks.en: Bayside apartment as your Chapter 3 home
Pay 'n' Spray shops buy and register cars with standard trackers

summary.en: {p:Jason} runs a deal for {p:Dre'Quan} and has to choose which product to bring.

unlock.en: Complete {i:Welcome to Vice City}.

text.en: As {p:Jason}, meet {p:Dre'Quan} in the studio above the {l:Jack of Hearts}.
Drive to the pick-up apartment.
Pick either the cut product or the pure product.
Drive to the deal south of the club and hand over the bag.
Wait while the buyer tests it, then take the backpack of money.
Knock out the man who tries to take the bag, then drive off.
Drive {p:Dre'Quan} toward {l:Southside}.
Settle the deal without violence for a Professional bonus.

tips.en: If you bring the cut product, the buyers notice. Offering it at half price keeps things peaceful.

summary.en: Dinner with {p:Brian} and {p:Lori} leads to a job at the dockyard: cut a car out of a container and get it to a lockup.

unlock.en: After {i:Dealer's Choice} and {p:Cal}'s visit about the hard drive, {p:Brian} gets in touch a day or two later.

text.en: Use the bag of clothes at the apartment and go to the rooftop restaurant on the east side.
Have dinner with {p:Brian} and {p:Lori}, then talk to Brian at the railing.
Drive the white van to the dockyard.
Find the yellow {i:SCOOP container} and cut it open with the {i:cut-off tool}.
Chase the truck that hauls the car away and jump onto it.
Free the car and lose the police.
Deliver the car to the lockup in the north-west of the city.
Order the Surf and Turf for {p:Lucia} for a small relationship boost.
Cut open other containers at the dock for extra loot.

unlocks.en: Both characters keep the cut-off tool

summary.en: A trip to an antiques shop in {l:Capri} about the {i:statue} becomes a three-part job with choices along the way.

missableNote.en: The Crowex Octane 'Bobby Ambrose' watch is only given if you hand over the statue at the first offer. If you decline and never hand it over, parts 2 and 3 expire at the end of Chapter 3.

unlock.en: Complete {i:Dealer's Choice}.

text.en: Use the bag in the apartment closet and travel to {l:Evelyn Andrews Antiques} in {l:Capri}.
Meet {p:Evelyn} and {p:Benedict Halifax}, then decide whether to lend him the {i:statue}.
Later, climb in through the shop window, let {p:Jason} in and find the {i:statue}.
Look for {p:Halifax} at the motel next door and decide whether to trust him.
Go to {p:Maryam}'s house in north-west {l:Capri}.
Chase {p:Halifax} by boat, {i:Seashark} and bike, and stop him.
Choose whether to shoot him or spare him.
Explore {l:Capri} together before leaving. The walk ends if you enter a shop or leave town.

tips.en: Hand over the {i:statue} at the first offer if you want the {i:Crowex Octane 'Bobby Ambrose' watch}.

unlocks.en: Crowex Octane 'Bobby Ambrose' watch (only if you hand over the statue at the first offer)
About $2,500 in jewelry and cash from the storage container

summary.en: {p:Lucia} helps {p:Mia} clear junk from a house in {l:Hamlet}, and the job gets messy.

text.en: As {p:Lucia}, meet {p:Mia} in {l:Peacock Bay} and drive to the house in {l:Hamlet}.
Follow {p:Mia} inside and look around the house.
Throw the junk on the front lawn into the blue dumpster.
Help {p:Mia} drag the mattress out of the pool.
Shoot the alligator that grabs {p:Mia}.
Use the excavator across the street on the gang's house and cars.
Drive {p:Mia}'s car to her office.

unlocks.en: Opens a side objective to send money to Lorena

summary.en: {p:Mia} is in trouble, and {p:Lucia} has to track her down and get her out.

unlock.en: After {i:Mami Knows Best}, {p:Mia} gets back in touch only after several in-game days.

text.en: As {p:Lucia}, read the note at {p:Mia}'s office in {l:Hamlet} and drive to the house.
Look for {p:Mia} inside, then head back out.
Tail the kidnappers' car from a distance.
Enter the building by the south-side door in the alley.
Drive {p:Terro}'s group around the three properties.
Follow {p:Mia}'s tour through to the backyard.
Fight off {p:Viper}'s crew.
Shoot {p:Viper} to free {p:Mia}.

tips.en: {p:Mia} takes several in-game days to call, so play other missions while you wait.
Expect the $2,000 payment to arrive many in-game days afterwards.

summary.en: {p:Jason} drops by {p:Tyrone}'s apartment to talk about work.

text.en: As {p:Jason}, go to {p:Tyrone}'s apartment.
Knock on the door and wait to be let in.
Talk to {p:Tyrone} about work.

summary.en: {p:Jason} hunts for {p:Charles} across the city to get hold of a bag of {i:Kitty Litter}.

unlock.en: Opens after part 1 of {i:Dubious Provenance}.

text.en: As {p:Jason}, go to {p:Charles}'s apartment in {l:Rockridge}.
Pay the neighbor $20 for a lead, or break in and read the receipt in the bedroom.
Go to the camp on the north-west edge of {l:La Perle} and break open the lower door.
Chase {p:Charles} up the stairs and over the wall.
Head back down and search him for the bag of {i:Kitty Litter}.

tips.en: You can knock out the vagrants at the camp by hand.

summary.en: An optional job for {p:Tyrone}: find the {i:Kitty Litter} labs hidden around {l:Vice City} and destroy them.

unlock.en: The first lab is assigned right after {i:Here, Kitty Kitty}.

text.en: Go to a marked search area and look for the building venting pink gas.
If a cook is there, question them first to learn where another lab is.
Destroy the lab equipment with fire or explosives.
Do the same in the other districts of {l:Vice City}.
Wait for {p:Tyrone} to offer the follow-up job {i:Spin On This}.

tips.en: The first lab is a trailer.
Labs can still be destroyed in free roam after the story, so there is no rush.

unlocks.en: Tyrone pays $2,000 or $2,500 per lab through BuckMe
Destroying enough labs opens Spin On This

summary.en: {p:Lucia} sneaks into a chop shop to steal a car for {p:Raul}.

unlock.en: About a day after {i:Meet the Heders}, {p:Raul} texts from a blocked number.

text.en: As {p:Lucia}, take the flash grenades and silenced pistol from the car trunk near the marker.
Climb onto the white van on the north side and cross the roof into the chop shop.
Find the {i:Schafter V12} and steal it.
Leave the area, and lose the police if they spot you.
Deliver the car to {l:Leonida Auto World} in the north-west of the city.
Leave the guard dog alone unless it attacks. Hurting it counts heavily against your criminal profile.

unlocks.en: Randy Kozlov becomes a vehicle drop-off

summary.en: A night out with the {p:Real Dimez} takes {p:Jason} and {p:Lucia} from the club to a house party.

unlock.en: After {i:Car Service}, {p:Dre'Quan} invites the pair to see the {p:Real Dimez}.

text.en: Go backstage at the {l:Jack of Hearts} and meet {p:Dre'Quan}.
Find the {p:Real Dimez} in the parking lot.
Follow {p:Roxy}'s car.
Stop at {l:Peewees}, order food and get into {p:Bae-Luxe}'s car.
At the house party, let {p:Jacki}'s dog out to draw her away from the door.
Knock out {p:Kamal}.
As {p:Jason}, cut the power at the box outside.
As {p:Lucia}, follow {p:Roxy} out.

summary.en: {p:Jason} drives {p:Boobie} around {l:Vice City} on a round of pick-ups that does not go to plan.

unlock.en: Opens after part 1 of {i:Dubious Provenance}; go to the club as {p:Jason}.

text.en: As {p:Jason}, meet {p:Boobie} at the {l:Jack of Hearts} and drive his car.
Make the two pick-ups. Honk the horn at the second stop.
Drive to the club by the river in the city center.
Chase the thieves on a {i:Seashark} and take back the cash bag.
Ride back and return to {p:Boobie}'s car.
Drive across the river to the smoke shop and meet {p:Yasmani}.

unlocks.en: Yasmani becomes a goods drop-off who pays more for jewelry and marked bills

summary.en: {p:Jason} and {p:Lucia} pick up {p:Raul} and get him across the city with the police on their tail.

unlock.en: Opens after {i:Car Service}; bring both characters.

text.en: Bring both characters to the garage on {l:Waxman Island} and open it at the wall keypad.
As {p:Lucia}, drive to the meeting point on the south side of {l:Ocean Beach} and pick up {p:Raul}.
Keep the police off you while {p:Jason} shoots from the passenger seat.
Drive to {l:Rialto Islands}.
Park in the marked lot and switch to the van.
Drive {p:Raul} to the drop-off at {l:Bayside}.
Shoot tires and engines, and wound officers instead of killing them, to keep a Professional or Hardened rating.

tips.en: The code for the garage keypad is 2404.

summary.en: Thieves hit the apartment, and {p:Jason} and {p:Lucia} each chase one down.

unlock.en: After {i:Boobie Time} and {i:First Impressions}, it starts the next time you try to enter the apartment.

text.en: As {p:Jason}, chase the first thief through the building site next door and stop them with a shot to the leg.
Search the thief's bag.
As {p:Lucia}, stop the second thief the same way and search the bag they drop.
Regroup outside the apartment and drive south to {l:Big House Storage}.
Follow {p:Jason} inside and take the elevator to his storage unit.

summary.en: {p:Jason} and {p:Lucia} split up to go after a boat on the river: one by bike, the other by metro.

unlock.en: Opens after {i:Car Service} once {p:Raul} calls.

text.en: Start as {p:Lucia} with {p:Raul} at the {l:Courtyard Bar}, or as {p:Jason} with {p:Karim} at the {l:La Perle} boatyard.
As {p:Jason}, follow the boats along the river by bike.
As {p:Lucia}, run to the next station and board the metro.
Confront the {p:Guardia} gang member on the train.
As {p:Jason}, hijack the boat.
As {p:Lucia}, hit the emergency stop.
Defend the boat until the pursuers are gone.

tips.en: Starting it with either character starts it for both.

summary.en: {p:Raul}'s crew sends {p:Jason} and {p:Lucia} to rob three Fleeca banks in a row.

unlock.en: Complete {i:Crosstown Traffic}.

text.en: Use the intercom with both characters and go inside.
Talk to {p:Andrea} and choose a pair of masks.
Talk to {p:Karim} and take the {i:dye pack jammer}.
Rob the Fleeca bank in {l:Washington Beach}.
Rob the second Fleeca in {l:Ocean Beach}.
Rob the last Fleeca further south and lose the police.
Return to the {l:Bayside} apartment and answer the door.
Disarm or wound guards instead of killing them to keep a Professional rating.

unlocks.en: Dye Pack Jammer, which lets you take marked bills
Banks and Payday Loans marked as robbery targets

summary.en: Learn to clone a car key, steal a {i:Zorrusso} from a walled parking garage and bring it to {p:Randy}.

unlock.en: Complete {i:Crosstown Traffic}.

text.en: Climb over the wall into the parking garage.
Install the {i:Key Cloner} app on your phone.
Find the {i:Zorrusso} on the ground level, on the east side.
Clone the key and take the car.
Drive to {p:Randy}'s showroom quickly, before the tracker alerts the police.
Follow {p:Randy} to his board to see the {i:Wish List}.
Deliver the car undamaged for a $10,000 bonus.
{p:Randy}'s {i:Wish List} of rare cars is optional. Deliver all of them for the trophy Supply & Demand.

unlocks.en: Key Cloner for stealing high-end cars

summary.en: A quiet visit to the {l:Sinfrontera National Bank} to study its security.

unlock.en: After {i:Credit Check}, {p:Raul} calls to meet at the bank.

text.en: Walk into the {l:Sinfrontera National Bank} through the front door.
Wait at the table with {p:Jason}.
Use Focus to inspect the cameras, the man in the pink suit, the two elevator guards and the security panel.
Go upstairs when {p:Raul} calls and sit down with him and {p:Andrea}.

summary.en: {p:Jason} and {p:Lucia} slip into a house in {l:Waning Sands} to bring someone back for the crew.

unlock.en: Starts right after {i:Sinfrontera National Bank}.

text.en: Drive to the marked house in {l:Waning Sands} and roll past it slowly.
Park nearby and sneak around the back behind {p:Jason}.
Go in when the guard steps outside and head for the north-east bedroom.
Pick up {p:Nicole}.
Follow {p:Jason} out and put her in the trunk.
Leave the area.
Drive to the planning room in {l:Stockyard}.

summary.en: {p:Dre'Quan} needs {p:Jason} to get close to {p:DWNPLY} and drive off in his car.

unlock.en: About a day after {i:Credit Check}, {p:Dre'Quan} messages {p:Jason} to come alone.

text.en: As {p:Jason}, meet {p:Dre'Quan} outside the {l:Jack of Hearts}.
Go to the {l:Eris} store and get a pair of {p:DWNPLY} sneakers.
Go back to {p:Dre'Quan} and show the shoes to get into the VIP lounge.
Give {p:DWNPLY} the shoes and take his keys while he is busy with them.
Find his car in the parking lot and steal it.
Lose the gang and get out of the red area.
Deliver the car to the {l:Speedshop}.
The sneakers cost $1,580, but if you throw a basketball at the seller he drops the bag and you get them for free.

summary.en: A weapons pick-up with {p:Brian} at an airfield is raided, and the cargo has to get out by road and by air.

missableNote.en: Each cargo box you lose here means one less charge in Hidden Charges.

unlock.en: Complete {i:Security Expert}.

text.en: Meet {p:Brian} at {l:Skeeter's} and follow him to his truck.
Drive to the airfield south of {l:Hamlet} and wait for {p:Pete}.
Load the weapon crates onto the truck.
Fight through the raid alongside {p:Pete}.
Take off in the plane before cars block the runway.
As {p:Lucia}, defend the cargo from the back of the truck.
As {p:Jason}, crash-land the plane in the field by the river.
Keep every cargo box for a Professional bonus.

tips.en: Protect the cargo boxes: each one lost costs you a charge in {i:Hidden Charges}.

summary.en: {p:Lucia} and {p:Andrea} grab a man named {p:Monty}, and the crew presses him for answers.

missableNote.en: Monty's 1992 Pistol, a weapon variant, can only be picked up in the photo room during this mission.

unlock.en: Opens after {i:Company Property}; go alone as {p:Lucia}.

text.en: As {p:Lucia}, meet {p:Andrea} at {l:Sloppy Molly's} and follow her to {p:Monty}.
Pose for the photos in the back room, then knock {p:Monty} out.
Pick up {p:Monty}'s pistol from the floor of the photo room.
Shoot your way out with {p:Andrea}.
Drive toward {l:Vice City} with {p:Monty} in the trunk.
As {p:Jason}, walk {p:Monty} to the backyard.
Use the loader to raise and lower him over the water while {p:Raul} asks questions.
Decide what happens to {p:Monty}.
Get through every question without killing {p:Monty} for a Professional bonus.

tips.en: Grab {i:Monty's 1992 Pistol} in the photo room. You cannot get it later.
Do not lower {p:Monty} all the way into the water. That kills him.

unlocks.en: Monty's 1992 Pistol (if you pick it up)

summary.en: The crew needs a safe to practice on, so {p:Jason} and {p:Lucia} take one from {p:Gil}'s mansion during a film shoot.

unlock.en: Opens after {i:Company Property}; talk to {p:Nicole} at the compound.

text.en: Talk to {p:Nicole} at the compound and drive the truck to {p:Gil}'s mansion in {l:Peacock Estates}.
As {p:Jason}, get onto the film set and play your part.
Knock out {p:Rodney}, then choose whether to keep filming.
Enter the mansion and find the safe remote in {p:Gil}'s office.
Open the window and hook the winch to the {i:safe}.
Drag the {i:safe} away and deliver it to {p:Felipe}.
Practice safecracking at the compound.
Avoid cyclists and gravestones while dragging the {i:safe}. Hitting them earns a Psycho rating.

tips.en: The $1,500 is the cash inside the practice safe.
Staying in the film shoot upsets {p:Lucia}.

summary.en: {p:Lucia} helps shoot a music video in {l:Crosstown}, and things get out of hand.

unlock.en: A couple of in-game days after {i:Ride or Die}, {p:Dre'Quan} gets in touch.

text.en: As {p:Lucia}, meet {p:Dre'Quan} at the marker in {l:Crosstown}.
Film the video by drifting the car in a circle.
Pull the man off {p:Roxy} and fight the second attacker.
Hit the car with the bat and spray-paint its side.
Drive away and lose {p:DWNPLY}'s crew until you are out of the red area.
Take the car to the studio.

summary.en: A pick-up for {p:Boobie} at an apartment block is raided, and {p:Jason} and {p:Lucia} have to get out with the bag.

missableNote.en: The $3,500 and the Professional bonus are only given if you take the red bag before leaving the first room.

unlock.en: Opens after {i:Hidden Charges} and the other open Chapter 3 main missions, when {p:Boobie} gets in touch.

text.en: Go back to the {l:Bayside} apartment, where {p:Boobie} is waiting.
Drive to {l:Venture Apartments} in {l:Rockridge} and park outside the red area.
Ask for {p:Raymond} in the lobby.
Grab the red bag of bricks when the raid starts and fight your way out.
Help {p:Lucia} out through the window.
Take a car and pick up {p:Jason}.
Lose the police.
Go to the {l:Jack of Hearts}.
Take the red bag in the first room for a Professional bonus and the cash from {p:Boobie}.

tips.en: Park outside the red area. A car left inside it gets impounded.
Pick up the red bag before you leave the first room, or you lose the $3,500 and the bonus.

summary.en: Heist prep: plant charges on three cell towers around downtown.

missableNote.en: You get up to three charges, minus one for each cargo box lost in Company Property. Each charge you plant adds time in The Cartel Heist.

unlock.en: After {i:Company Property} and {i:Cooties}, {p:Karim} calls you to the planning room.

text.en: Meet {p:Karim} at the planning room and take the van.
Drive to the marked garage downtown and park.
Plant a charge on the East cell tower.
Plant a charge on the South cell tower.
Plant a charge on the West cell tower.
Get clear of the police search area.
Split the towers between {p:Jason} and {p:Lucia}. It is faster and raises their relationship.

tips.en: You can do the towers in any order.
At the West tower, the workers are quick to call in trespassers.

unlocks.en: More time in The Cartel Heist for each charge planted

summary.en: Everything the crew has prepared comes together in the biggest job of the chapter.

unlock.en: Finish {i:Hidden Charges} and every other Chapter 3 main mission, then meet {p:Raul} at the planning room.

text.en: Leave the planning room, drive toward the cell towers and park.
Enter the bank and wait for the go-ahead from {p:Karim}.
Take the lobby, then ride the elevator up to deal with the security team.
Secure the backup terminal on the roof.
Open the vault and bag the cash.
Hold off the police and regroup with {p:Raul}.
Get {p:Nicole} and reach the bus through the basement and the delivery bay.
Defend the bus and escape on the freeway.
Shoot weapons out of guards' hands instead of killing them to keep a Professional rating.

tips.en: Each charge planted in {i:Hidden Charges} gives you more time here.

summary.en: {p:Jason} and {p:Lucia} trade the {l:Bayside} apartment for a suite at the {l:Y Hotel} and settle in.

unlock.en: Opens after {i:The Cartel Heist}; start it the next time you are at the {l:Bayside} apartment.

text.en: Head out of the {l:Bayside} apartment and drive to the {l:Y Hotel}.
Find {p:Valentina} in the lobby and walk with her to the elevator.
Go up to the 7th floor and walk to {l:Room 701} at the far end of the hallway.
Explore the suite with {p:Lucia} and open the wardrobe.
Pick up a {i:champagne glass} from the counter and take it to {p:Lucia} on the balcony.

unlocks.en: New outfits in the suite wardrobe

summary.en: A short, quiet flashback played as {p:Lucia} at her old home.

unlock.en: Starts automatically when {i:Ocean Beach} ends.

text.en: Pick up the {i:phone} from the table.
Go to the room at the end of the hallway and lift {p:Tomás} out of his crib.
Carry {p:Tomás} to the living room and try the objects there to settle him.
Turn up the {i:radio} on the counter.
Dance with {p:Tomás}, then watch the closing scenes.

unlocks.en: BuckMe Black account with a $2,000,000 account limit
Trophy or achievement: Vice City, Baby!

summary.en: A slow afternoon at the {l:Y Hotel} pool with {p:Lucia}, plus a first meeting with {p:Eddie Acosta}.

unlock.en: Starts right after {i:Another Life}.

text.en: Join {p:Lucia} on the suite balcony and agree to head down to the pool.
Walk past the pool to the bar and order a {i:Tequila Sunrise}.
Talk to {p:Eddie Acosta} when he stops you on the way back.
Hand {p:Lucia} her drink and people-watch with her.
Walk to the beach with {p:Lucia}.

tips.en: Saying yes or no to {p:Eddie Acosta}'s invitation changes nothing; his party is marked on the map either way.

unlocks.en: Optional mission: Attend Eddie Acosta's Party
Company Cars and Lawyer Up, after a call from Valentina

summary.en: Pick out a dealership car for each of {p:Jason} and {p:Lucia}, then race back to the hotel.

unlock.en: Available after {i:Pool Day}; talk to the concierge in the {l:Y Hotel} lobby.

text.en: Talk to {p:Santino} in the {l:Y Hotel} lobby and take the car service to {l:Status Auto Imports}.
Speak to the salesman, then follow {p:Rob} to the cars on the far side of the showroom.
Sit in a car to pick it for {p:Jason}.
Pick a second car for {p:Lucia}.
Chase {p:Lucia}, then race her back to the {l:Y Hotel}.

tips.en: Any car can be chosen and both are kept; the {i:Pfister Comet S2} is the fastest of the bunch.
Damage picked up during the race does not matter.
The hotel car service is a free ride to the dealership, and either character can start the mission.

unlocks.en: One dealership car each for Jason and Lucia, both kept

summary.en: {p:Valentina} lines up a lawyer, and you go to meet {p:Abe Gonzalez} at his office in {l:Downtown} Vice City.

unlock.en: Available after {i:Pool Day}, once {p:Valentina} calls about a lawyer.

text.en: Drive to {p:Abe Gonzalez}'s office in {l:Downtown} Vice City.
Speak to the receptionist.
Meet {p:Sandy}, the assistant, at the back of the office.
Go upstairs and meet {p:Abe Gonzalez}.

tips.en: {p:Abe Gonzalez} charges a $75,000 fee that comes due after {i:Party Hard}, so keep that much cash free.

summary.en: Collect a {i:hard drive} for {p:Raul}, then go undercover at {l:Ajax Gym} to learn about a crew of bodybuilders.

unlock.en: Available after {i:Lawyer Up}, when {p:Raul} asks for the {i:hard drive}.

text.en: Ride the elevator up to the storage locker in {l:Crosstown} and pick up the {i:hard drive}.
Meet {p:Raul} on his houseboat in {l:Leonard County}.
Take the boat south and dock at {l:Ajax Gym}.
Follow {p:J-Wang} on the gym tour, then change at the locker as {p:Lucia} and search {p:Raina}'s backpack.
Work out to blend in, then make your way to the tanning salon.
Trap {p:Nate} in a tanning bed with a {i:lifting strap} and read the messages on his phone.
At night, tail the bodybuilders' car to the {l:Grand Majestic Aparthotel} without getting too close.
Follow them inside and take the elevator to the roof.

tips.en: While tailing the car, drop back whenever the marker over it turns yellow.
This mission and {i:Party Hard} both open after {i:Lawyer Up}, so you can play them in either order.

summary.en: An optional night out: {p:Jason} and {p:Lucia} have a drink together at the {l:Courtyard Bar}.

unlock.en: Marked on the map after {i:Heavy Lifting}; bring {p:Jason} and {p:Lucia} together.

text.en: Go to the {l:Courtyard Bar} in {l:Stockyard} with both characters.
Buy a drink at the bar.
Leave the bar area and walk back out to the street.

tips.en: Dancing at the bar is possible but not needed.
Skipping this mission has no consequences.

summary.en: A personal security job for {p:Valentina} that starts with an airport pickup and turns into a firefight at the {l:Megamundo} offices.

unlock.en: Available after {i:Lawyer Up}, when {p:Valentina} offers a security job.

text.en: Meet {p:Valentina} at {l:VCIA}, pick up {p:Andrés de León} and follow the lead car out of the airport.
Stop in {l:Little Cuba} for his drink order, then drive to the {l:Megamundo} offices in {l:Downtown}.
Follow {p:Andrés de León} inside, take the elevator and check on him in the conference room.
Fight off the gunmen, clear the floor and pick up the {i:radio}.
As {p:Lucia}, reach the stairwell, crawl through the vent and quietly clear the party floor with the {i:silenced pistol}.
Untie {p:Valentina} and check on the Navarros.
As {p:Jason}, jump onto the departing helicopter and fight the kidnappers.
Fly back and land on the {l:Megamundo} rooftop helipad.

tips.en: The {i:silenced pistol} on the party floor comes with no spare ammo, so make every shot count.
A loud shot or being seen alerts the whole party floor, and take care not to hit the hostages.

summary.en: A short phone task: settle the $75,000 bill from {p:Abe Gonzalez}'s law firm so the story can move on.

unlock.en: Appears right after {i:Party Hard}, when the law firm texts you.

text.en: Wait for the text from the law firm after {i:Party Hard}.
Open the {i:BuckMe} app on your phone.
Send the $75,000 fee to {p:Abe Gonzalez}'s firm.

tips.en: The payment is required before the story continues.
There is no map marker for this one; look for it in the story mission list.

summary.en: A promo shoot for {p:Dre'Quan} on a {l:Tequesta} rooftop goes wrong and ends in a chase across the city.

unlock.en: Available after {i:Party Hard}.

text.en: Meet {p:Dre'Quan} at the marked building in {l:Tequesta} and follow him up to the roof.
As {p:Lucia}, use the phone camera to photograph the Dimez posing in the helicopter.
As {p:Jason}, fly the helicopter and follow the car carrying {p:Dre'Quan} from the air.
Switch to {p:Lucia} on a bike, keep the car in view and shoot the extra cars that join the chase.
Fight through the gang in the alley under the highway.
Clear the reinforcements and reach the car at the end of the alley.

tips.en: Shooting the car that carries {p:Dre'Quan} does nothing, so save your ammo for the cars that join in.

summary.en: An optional job for {p:Andrea}: track down {p:Felipe} in {l:Millport} and decide what happens to him.

missableNote.en: This mission is gone for good once Power Play has been started, so play it before then.

unlock.en: Available after {i:Party Hard}, when {p:Andrea} asks you to deal with {p:Felipe}.

text.en: Go to the marked bar in {l:Millport} and walk to the back.
Chase {p:Felipe} when he bolts toward the woods.
Shoot him in the legs or back to slow him down, then hit him until he gives up.
Question {p:Felipe} about why he walked away from the Cartel heist.
Choose whether to spare him or kill him.

tips.en: Killing {p:Felipe} earns $20,000 from {p:Andrea}; sparing him pays nothing but opens a follow-up, {i:Collect Felipe's Gift}.
Either character can play this mission.

unlocks.en: If Felipe is spared: follow-up Collect Felipe's Gift (his vehicle)

summary.en: An optional solo visit to {p:Eddie Acosta}'s rooftop party at {l:Heathcliff Heights}, where he asks you for money.

unlock.en: A few days after {i:Pool Day}, {p:Eddie Acosta} texts an invitation.

text.en: Wait a few days after {i:Pool Day} for the invitation from {p:Eddie Acosta}.
Go alone to {l:Heathcliff Heights} and walk into the lobby.
Meet {p:Eddie Acosta} at the elevator and ride up to the rooftop.
Pay the $50,000 he asks for, or refuse.
If you refuse, ride the {i:bike} flat out over the solar panels to the next roof and take the elevator down.
Confront {p:Eddie Acosta} in the lobby if he is waiting there.

tips.en: This one is solo only: go as {p:Jason} or {p:Lucia} without your partner.
Paying costs $50,000 and gets you only a worthless NFT; refusing costs nothing, and there is no reward either way.
Shooting at {p:Eddie Acosta} does not hurt him and only makes him run instead of waiting in the lobby.

summary.en: An optional pickup: {p:Dre'Quan} leaves a race bike for you in {l:La Perle}.

unlock.en: A few in-game days after {i:Photo/Shoot}, {p:Dre'Quan} gets in touch and the gift is marked on the map.

text.en: Wait a few in-game days after {i:Photo/Shoot} for {p:Dre'Quan} to contact you.
Go to the alley behind the {l:Pay'n'Spray} in {l:La Perle}.
Collect the {i:SFB 1000} race bike.

tips.en: Either character can collect the bike.

unlocks.en: KD's SFB 1000 race bike, yours to keep or sell

summary.en: {p:Lucia} joins {l:Ajax Gym} and trains alongside {p:Nate} in the first setup job for {i:VCIA Takedown}.

missableNote.en: From this mission until VCIA Takedown, Jason and Lucia cannot be seen together in public and can only meet in their Y Hotel room, so do any couple activities first. The steroid choice is permanent: accepting changes Lucia's physique for the rest of the game.

unlock.en: A couple of in-game days after {i:Heavy Lifting}, {p:Raul} contacts {p:Lucia}.

text.en: Once {p:Raul} gets in touch, go to the planning room alone as {p:Lucia}.
Find {p:Nate} by the weight benches upstairs at {l:Ajax Gym} and keep talking until he notices you.
Do the bench press, squat rack and deadlift with {p:Nate}, then use the exercise bike by the pool.
Sit through the training montage, then accept or decline the steroids {p:Nate} offers.
Leave the gym and meet {p:Jason} outside.
Drive to the planning room and use the intercom to get in.

tips.en: Declining the steroids is the default; accepting them permanently changes {p:Lucia}'s physique.

summary.en: {p:Lucia} works out on the {l:Trauma Floor} at {l:Ajax Gym} and meets the rest of {p:Kordell}'s crew.

unlock.en: Available after {i:Making Gainz}.

text.en: Go to the {l:Trauma Floor} at {l:Ajax Gym}.
Change into workout clothes at the locker.
Head down the steps and talk to {p:Nate}.
Train on the equipment near {p:Raina}, then near {p:Nate} and {p:Cisco}, then deadlift on the stage with {p:Kordell}.
Answer {p:Kordell} when he comes over, then speak to the rest of the crew.
Leave the gym.

tips.en: Any answer to {p:Kordell}'s question works.
This workout has to be done before {i:Amateur Hour} opens.

summary.en: {p:Jason} scouts {l:Vice City International Airport} from the inside while working with the baggage crew.

unlock.en: Available after {i:Making Gainz}; {p:Raul} sends {p:Jason} to look over the airport.

text.en: Drive to {l:Vice City International Airport}, park in the lot and meet {p:Andrea} at the office.
Ride along with {p:Omar} and scan the highlighted points of interest for {p:Karim}.
Hitch the {i:baggage tug} to the two trailers and drive to the plane at the south end of the airport.
Throw bags to {p:Omar}, timing each throw with the power bar.
Make an excuse to step away and go through the loading bay to the security office.
Plant the {i:bug} behind the toilet in the restroom.
Return to {p:Omar} and tell him you want the job.

tips.en: {i:Dirty Work} will not open until this mission is done.

summary.en: {p:Jason} backs up {p:Dre'Quan} on a watch deal that turns into a shootout, then gets dressed up for a meeting.

unlock.en: Available after {i:Making Gainz}.

text.en: Meet {p:Dre'Quan} upstairs in the marked store.
Drive to the {l:Cruda} parking lot and go up to the top floor.
Help {p:Dre'Quan} knock out the two watch dealers.
Fight off the gunmen arriving by car and from the stairs, then leave before the police turn up.
Drive to {l:Nola} near the south end of {l:Ocean Beach} and choose one of the two outfits.
Drive north to the {l:Doight d'Or} hotel and follow {p:Dre'Quan} out the back.
Wait while he talks with {p:Royce Jones}.

tips.en: It is not a heist setup job, but it leads to {i:Fresh Evidence} and {i:Headliners}, which you need before the airport heist.

unlocks.en: The outfit you pick at Nola, paid for by Dre'Quan

summary.en: {p:Lucia} helps {p:Cisco} chase down a camper and get his money back.

unlock.en: Available after {p:Lucia}'s first workout with the crew in {i:Blood Sweat and Gear}.

text.en: Talk to {p:Cisco} on the {l:Trauma Floor} at {l:Ajax Gym}.
Change outfit at your locker and follow him out the back to his car.
Drive to the pick-up spot on {l:Washington Island} and wait on the bench for the camper.
Chase the camper and shoot out its tires to stop it.
Wait while {p:Cisco} gets his money back.
Drive him back to {l:Ajax Gym} and park in his spot.

summary.en: A quick phone step: {p:Lucia} answers a text from {p:Nate} with a call to set up their next job.

unlock.en: Appears after {i:Amateur Hour}, when {p:Nate} texts {p:Lucia}.

text.en: Wait for {p:Nate}'s text after {i:Amateur Hour}.
Switch to {p:Lucia}.
Call {p:Nate} from the phone, or select the entry on the map to dial him.

summary.en: A back-alley deal with {p:Nate} goes bad, and {p:Lucia} has to win back his stolen car.

unlock.en: Available after {i:Amateur Hour} and the call with {p:Nate}.

text.en: Meet {p:Nate} at the {l:Muscle Beach} gym on {l:Ocean Beach} and follow him to his car.
Drive to the back alley and open the trunk when he asks.
Knock the gun away from the man next to you and take out the other buyers.
Take the car left in the alley and chase {p:Nate}'s stolen car without shooting at the driver.
Clear out the gunmen at the motel parking lot and take the car back.
Lose the police.
Drive to the ice cream shop in northern {l:Vice Beach}.

summary.en: {p:Andrea} sends {p:Jason} and {p:Lucia} to a {l:Tequesta} motel to catch {p:Raina} on camera.

unlock.en: Opens once {i:Too Much Baggage} and {i:Cash Injections} are both complete.

text.en: Meet {p:Andrea} in the planning room.
Drive to the {l:Velvet Palm Motel} in {l:Tequesta}.
As {p:Lucia}, choose a vantage point; the shipping containers give a clear view of the windows.
As {p:Jason}, keep pressing the prompted button to hold {p:Raina} off until a window is open.
As {p:Lucia}, photograph the two of them through the window.
As {p:Jason}, drive around the building and meet {p:Lucia} in the alley.
The next day, go upstairs at the gym as {p:Lucia} and talk to {p:Nate} on a lounger by the pool.

summary.en: A waiting step: {p:Lucia} holds on for a call from {p:Nate} while other story missions are wrapped up.

unlock.en: Appears in the mission list right after {i:Dirty Work}.

text.en: Finish {p:Jason}'s open story missions, up to and including {i:Child's Play}.
Switch to {p:Lucia}.
Wait for {p:Nate}'s call.

tips.en: The call only comes while you are playing as {p:Lucia}.
It needs {i:Too Much Baggage}, {i:Watch It}, {i:Adventures in Babysitting}, {i:Rafa's Kidnapping}, {i:Fresh Evidence} and {i:Child's Play} done first.
The call leads straight into {i:Power Play}.

summary.en: {p:Jason} works security for {p:Andrés de León} on a night out at {l:The Vault} that ends in a running gunfight.

unlock.en: {p:Jason} gets a call some time after {i:Making Gainz}.

text.en: Meet {p:Andrés de León} behind his house on {l:Starfish Island} and drive him to {l:The Vault} nightclub.
Get him a drink from the bar, then bring a group of women over to his booth.
Find {p:Andrés de León} in the last restroom stall.
Fetch his package from the car outside and take it back to him.
Protect him when gunmen attack and shoot your way out of the club.
Use the mounted {i:LMG} to stop the vehicles chasing your car.
Follow {p:Paulo} through the building and up to the rooftop helipad.
Defend the helicopter against the enemy helicopters.

tips.en: Hitting civilians as they run hurts your Criminal Profile rating, so check your fire in the club.
Accepting or turning down the drugs {p:Andrés de León} offers has no lasting effect.

summary.en: A waiting step for {p:Jason}: finish his other missions, and a phone call sets up what comes next.

unlock.en: Appears after {i:Adventures in Babysitting}.

text.en: Finish {p:Jason}'s remaining story missions, including {i:Watch It} and {i:Fresh Evidence}.
Wait for the phone call from {p:Abe Gonzalez}.
Head to {i:Child's Play}, which is marked when the call ends.

summary.en: {p:Jason} and {p:Dre'Quan} sneak into a {l:Starfish Island} mansion at night to copy evidence, then fight their way out.

unlock.en: Opens once {i:Watch It} and {i:Adventures in Babysitting} are both complete.

text.en: Meet {p:Dre'Quan} in his office at {l:Jack of Hearts} and follow him to the car.
Drive to {l:Starfish Island} and climb into {p:Dante Fresh}'s mansion after dark.
Knock out the guard and take the {i:key card} from the bedside table.
Throw a {i:bottle} to distract the guards and lure the tiger away with {i:raw meat} from the fridge.
Take the elevator to the basement and open the hidden room behind the gold mural.
Wait while {p:Dre'Quan} copies the evidence in the surveillance room.
Fight back up through the mansion and get to the dock.
Take the speedboat and lose the police.

tips.en: A round of rock-paper-scissors decides who opens the hidden door; if you lose, solve the mural puzzle yourself by matching the symbol.

summary.en: A high-stakes job for {p:Andrés de León} that begins at {l:Megamundo HQ} and switches between {p:Jason} and {p:Lucia}.

unlock.en: Available after {i:Fresh Evidence}, once the call from {p:Abe Gonzalez} comes in.

text.en: Meet {p:Andrés de León} at {l:Megamundo HQ} in {l:Downtown} and drive to the exchange at the quarry.
As {p:Lucia}, tag the enemies with the {i:binoculars} and locate {p:Rafa}.
Get {p:Rafa} out of the guarded building using the {i:silenced pistol}.
As {p:Jason}, protect {p:Andrés de León} from the kidnappers.
As {p:Lucia}, carry {p:Rafa} out and hand him over to {p:Gustavo}.
Chase the kidnappers by car and bike and bring down the helicopter.
Free {p:Rafa} from the crashed SUV.
Catch {p:Gustavo} on the highway.

tips.en: The map shows a time limit, but there is no real timer: the game only forces this mission once every other {p:Jason} and {p:Lucia} mission before {i:Power Play} is done.
Either character can start it.

title.en: This is a Free Call From…

summary.en: An optional favor for {p:Lucia}: collect {p:Shayna} from prison and back her up on a visit in {l:Southside}.

missableNote.en: Time-sensitive: it is only offered for a limited time during Chapter 4, so start it soon after it is marked on the map.

unlock.en: Needs {i:Lawyer Up}; the call comes in while driving near {l:Hamlet} as {p:Lucia}.

text.en: Drive near {l:Hamlet} as {p:Lucia} to get the call, then pick up {p:Shayna} at the prison.
Drive her to {p:Raph}'s house in {l:Southside}.
Go inside with her and either tell her to shoot or talk her down.
When the gang members walk in, talk them down or shoot them.
Split the bag with {p:Shayna}.

tips.en: The payout is loot, not a fixed sum, and how you handle {p:Shayna} and the gang changes what you walk away with.

summary.en: {p:Lucia} rides along on an armored truck robbery with {p:Kordell}'s crew while {p:Jason} sneaks a look at their plans.

missableNote.en: Starting Power Play permanently closes the optional mission Bad Driver!, so play that one first if you want it.

unlock.en: Available after {i:Child's Play}, once {p:Nate} calls {p:Lucia}; only she can start it.

text.en: Ask the receptionist for {p:Kordell} at the crew's base in {l:Salton} and go to him.
As {p:Jason}, get in over the roof and sneak to the planning room.
Photograph the heist plans on the back of the {i:whiteboard}.
As {p:Lucia}, block the road with {i:cones}.
Pick up the assault rifle and cover the crew while they rob the armored truck.
Follow {p:Kordell} on foot through the construction site to the highway.
Steal a car and lose the police.

summary.en: {p:Jason} flies a {i:drone} for {p:Karim} to listen in on the bodybuilders and plant {i:cameras} in an apartment.

unlock.en: Available after {i:Power Play}.

text.en: Meet {p:Karim} at his van on the top floor of the parking garage in {l:Ocean Beach}.
Fly the {i:drone} to the rooftop bar at {l:The Calique} and find {p:Nate} and {p:Cisco}.
Stay close enough to listen without being spotted, then follow their car from above.
Fly in through the open balcony door of {p:Omar}'s apartment.
Place the {i:cameras} in the living room, kitchen and bedroom while keeping out of {p:Omar}'s sight.
Watch the interrogation through the cameras.
Fly the {i:drone} out and land it back at the van.
Drive {p:Lucia} to the alley near {l:Ajax Gym}.
Professional bonus for your Criminal Profile: bring the {i:drone} back to the van.

summary.en: {p:Jason} rides a delivery bike into the airport and uses a {i:flash drive} on the computers in the {l:TSS} office.

unlock.en: Available after {i:Power Play}.

text.en: Meet {p:Andrea} in the planning room.
Ride the delivery bike to the airport security gate and walk into the {l:TSS} office.
Talk to the receptionist, then plug the {i:flash drive} into her computer once she leaves.
Pull the fire alarm behind the reception desk.
Go up to the second floor and plug the {i:flash drive} into the computer in the back-left office.
Take the drive and ride out of the airport.
Professional bonus for your Criminal Profile: get in and out without being caught.

tips.en: Do not linger on the upstairs hack: if it takes too long, the staff come back and you are reported for trespassing.

summary.en: {p:Kordell} takes {p:Lucia} to a warehouse for a run of cage fights, then on to a bar.

unlock.en: Available after {i:Power Play}.

text.en: Meet {p:Kordell} at {l:Ajax Gym} and follow him to his car in the alley.
Drive to the warehouse and enter through the door on the left side.
Win the cage fights; {p:Kordell} joins you against the last fighters.
After {p:Arlo} leaves, get back in the car and drive to the {l:Riverbank Waterside Bar}.
Follow {p:Kordell} into the bar.

tips.en: The fights are won with timed dodge and block prompts.

summary.en: Steal a {i:catering truck} from the airport without being noticed, then help get the bags ready for the heist.

unlock.en: Available after {i:Power Play}; {p:Raul} gets in touch around the time {i:Close Surveillance} and {i:Delivery Method} are done.

text.en: Go to the marked spot at the airport.
Climb onto the roof of the building beside the parked catering trucks, keeping out of the workers' sight.
Drop down next to the middle truck and break in.
Drive the {i:catering truck} out of the airport to the drop-off in {l:Rockridge}.
In the planning room, fill the bags with fake cash until they are full.

tips.en: Workers who spot you report you for trespassing, so stay out of their line of sight.
Either {p:Jason} or {p:Lucia} can play this one.

summary.en: A waiting step: once every setup job is done, {p:Lucia} gets the call that the airport heist is ready.

unlock.en: Needs {i:Fully Catered}, every other {i:VCIA Takedown} setup job and {i:Headliners}.

text.en: Finish every {i:VCIA Takedown} setup job and {i:Headliners}.
Play as {p:Lucia}.
Wait for the call the next morning.

tips.en: Until the setup jobs are done, the map lists this entry as Heist Planning.

summary.en: {p:Jason} and {p:Lucia} help {p:Dre'Quan} run a launch party at {l:Club VYB}, from the DJ booth to the VIP tables, until trouble starts on stage.

unlock.en: Opens once the other {i:VCIA Takedown} setup jobs are done, and must be finished before the heist.

text.en: Meet {p:Dre'Quan} by the entrance of {l:Club VYB} in {l:Washington Beach} and follow him around.
As {p:Lucia}, try out the lights and effects in the DJ booth.
As {p:Jason}, decide who gets the three VIP tables.
As {p:Lucia}, check on the VIP tables, starting with {p:Maleek Rivers}.
As {p:Jason}, meet {p:Dre'Quan} outside, bring the arriving VIP group in and clear one table for them.
As {p:Lucia}, pull {p:DWNPLY} off the stage and fight off his crew.
Beat the brawler upstairs as {p:Jason}, then knock out {p:DWNPLY} as {p:Lucia}.
Watch the Dimez perform and answer {p:Dre'Quan}'s stay-or-leave question.

tips.en: The payout tops out at about $50,000 and depends on which guests get the VIP tables and which group you later move out.
Smaller choices come up too: whether to let {p:KD} in, whether to throw out the man in the lobby, and whether to stay or leave at the end.

summary.en: The airport heist that the whole chapter builds toward: a long, multi-stage job for both {p:Jason} and {p:Lucia}.

unlock.en: Needs every setup mission: {i:Making Gainz}, {i:Too Much Baggage}, {i:Amateur Hour}, {i:Cash Injections}, {i:Dirty Work}, {i:Adventures in Babysitting}, {i:Power Play}, {i:Close Surveillance}, {i:Delivery Method}, {i:Team Building}, {i:Fully Catered} and {i:Headliners}.

text.en: Start in the planning room, then follow {p:Nate} through the airport as {p:Lucia} while {p:Jason} drives the {i:catering truck} to the cargo terminal.
Knock out {p:Janice} in the restroom and follow the vault manager with the wine crate.
As {p:Jason}, reach the network terminal on the airport roof within the 5-minute limit.
As {p:Lucia}, open the vault gates using the two buttons.
As {p:Jason}, knock out {p:Omar} and hide him in a container, then help load the bags onto the plane.
Fight through the police on the tarmac, chase the plane and get {p:Lucia} aboard.
Win the fights on board the plane and stop the getaway truck on the highway.
Defend {p:Andrea} while she loads the van, then hold the plane steady until it comes down in {l:Vice City Bay}.
Professional bonus for your Criminal Profile: do not kill {p:Omar}; knock him out or wound him in the leg.

unlocks.en: Jason and Lucia can be seen together in public again

summary.en: A waiting step after the heist: pass the time until there is news about the sale of the {i:hard drive}.

unlock.en: Starts straight after {i:VCIA Takedown}.

text.en: Wait for news about the sale of the {i:hard drive}.
Fill the time with other activities; the optional job from {p:Yasmani} opens now.
When {p:Valentina} rings, call her back to move things along sooner.

tips.en: This is the last stretch of free roam in Chapter 4 before the point of no return at {i:Sunset}, so finish optional missions and side activities now.

summary.en: An optional bank vault job that starts with a tip from {p:Yasmani} about a security van.

unlock.en: After {i:VCIA Takedown}, {p:Yasmani} sends a tip about a security van.

text.en: Sit by the window at {l:Café Orquídea} in {l:Ocean Beach} and wait for the security van.
Tail the van without alarming the driver.
Follow the guard into the bank on foot.
Put on a disguise, blow open the back doorway and deal with the vault guards.
Grab the {i:marked bills} from the cart, passing full bags to your partner.
Leave through the front and lose the four-star wanted level.
Sell the bills to {p:Yasmani}.

tips.en: The take is about $80,000 if you grab every one of the {i:marked bills}, so empty the cart before you leave.
It opens just before {i:Sunset}, which closes the open world for most of Chapter 5, so consider playing it first.

unlocks.en: Yasmani starts selling Security Van tips for repeatable bank vault jobs

summary.en: A quick phone step: return {p:Valentina}'s call about the sale to bring on the next mission sooner.

unlock.en: Appears after {i:VCIA Takedown}, once {p:Valentina} has called about the sale.

text.en: Wait for {p:Valentina}'s call after the airport heist.
Call her back from either character's phone, or select the entry on the map.
Go to the {l:Y Hotel} front desk when the next mission appears.

tips.en: The call is optional; it only makes {i:Sunset} appear sooner than waiting would.
{i:Sunset} is the point of no return for Chapter 4, so wrap up everything else before you go to the front desk.

summary.en: A note left at the {l:Y Hotel} front desk leads into the turning point of Chapter 4.

missableNote.en: Starting this mission is the point of no return for Chapter 4. The story moves into Chapter 5 and the open world stays closed until most of that chapter is done, so finish side activities and optional Chapter 4 missions first.

unlock.en: After {i:VCIA Takedown}, wait or call {p:Valentina} back, then collect the note left at the {l:Y Hotel} front desk.

text.en: Pick up the note at the {l:Y Hotel} front desk.
Drive to the marina on the south side of {l:Vice Beach} as the sun goes down.
Board {p:Raul}'s houseboat and search it, finishing in the small bathroom.
Fight along the docks through the police and bring down the helicopter.
Get into the boat at the end of the dock.
Take turns driving and shooting, restocking from the {i:gun locker}.
Jump off between the barges to lose the pursuers.

tips.en: The note is at the hotel's front desk, not the concierge's desk.
Ammo on the boat is limited; swap characters or restock from the {i:gun locker}.
