summary.en: The last mission of Chapter 4: {p:Jason} and {p:Lucia} keep a low profile while they work out their next move.

unlock.en: Starts automatically after {i:Sunset}.

text.en: Drive to {l:Aqua Stadium} without being seen by the police.
Find {p:Andrea} in the stands at the southwest end.
Leave your car, steal another near the boat storage and drive to {l:Big House Storage Inc} in {l:Crosstown} for the {i:statue}.
Follow the text from {p:Mattia} to the hotel and take the elevator up to the terrace.
Go through the test in {p:Giorgio Gallo}'s penthouse.
Follow {p:Giorgio Gallo}, then {p:Dardan}, to the bedroom.

tips.en: If the police spot you on the way to the stadium, {p:Andrea} leaves and drops the {i:hard drive} for you to pick up instead.
What you choose during the penthouse test does not change the outcome.

unlocks.en: Trophy or achievement: Top Of The World, Ma (Chapter 4 complete)
The first Chapter 5 mission starts right away

summary.en: The first job of Chapter 5: a scouting flight followed by a long infiltration that mixes stealth and heavy combat.

unlock.en: Starts right after the last mission of Chapter 4.

text.en: Change clothes at the wardrobe and meet {p:Giorgio} in the penthouse gym.
Fly the helicopter over the coast guard base and scout it as {p:Lucia}.
Fly to the bridge on the west edge of the city to meet {p:Kevin}, then skydive onto the boat.
Take the boat to the spot south of the military base.
Cut the grate and follow {p:Vinny} through the sewer into the base.
Sneak to the hangar, climb the side ladders and enter through the roof hatch.
As {p:Lucia}, open the hangar doors from the console and hold off the soldiers until you can board.
Defend the stolen helicopter and shoot down the jets with the {i:rocket launcher}.
Professional bonus for your Criminal Profile: reach the hangar roof hatch without being detected.

tips.en: The open world is closed during this stretch of Chapter 5.

summary.en: A short, scene-led mission back at the penthouse that sets up the rest of the chapter.

unlock.en: Starts automatically once you are back in the penthouse after {i:Bird in the Hand}.

text.en: Return to the penthouse after {i:Bird in the Hand}.
Meet {p:Giorgio} in the spa room next to the gym.
Follow him to his office and watch the scene.

unlocks.en: Missions Doggie Bag and VC Baby

summary.en: A stealth job for {p:Vinny}: slip in quietly, find your target and get out by air.

unlock.en: Available after {i:Taking Liberties}.

text.en: Talk to {p:Vinny} on the poolside balcony of the penthouse.
Sneak aboard the docked cruise ship, knocking out guards with non-lethal rounds.
Take the elevator to the top deck.
Find {p:Rocco} near the pool at the back of the ship.
Feed him the drugged {i:biscuit} and pick him up once he is asleep.
Carry him to the landing zone at the southeast end and board the helicopter.

tips.en: This mission and {i:VC Baby} open together and can be played in either order; the next mission needs both.
The stealth section is played as {p:Lucia}, whose {i:silenced pistol} fires non-lethal rounds here.

summary.en: {p:Mattia} asks for a personal favor, and how you answer decides how the mission plays out.

missableNote.en: Refusing Mattia ends the mission immediately and skips the drive and the scene that follows. Missions cannot be replayed, so choose carefully.

unlock.en: Available after {i:Taking Liberties}.

text.en: Walk over to {p:Kat} and {p:Mattia} in the penthouse and follow them to the elevator.
Agree to help {p:Mattia}; refusing ends the mission at once.
Wait for {p:Lucia} to distract {p:Dardan}, then take the {i:key fob} from the couch.
Meet {p:Mattia} at the car elevator, ride down and choose one of the cars in the garage.
Drive him to the hospital in the northeast of the city before the timer runs out.
Follow him inside.
Top bonus, above Professional: reach the hospital in time; the limit is just under 4 minutes.

tips.en: Say yes to {p:Mattia} if you want to play the full mission; a refusal ends it on the spot and cannot be undone.
This mission and {i:Doggie Bag} can be played in either order.

summary.en: A long, multi-stage heist that switches between {p:Jason} and {p:Lucia} from start to finish.

unlock.en: Starts automatically at the penthouse once {i:Doggie Bag} and {i:VC Baby} are both done.

text.en: Meet {p:Vinny} upstairs in the penthouse and take the boat to the bridge.
As {p:Lucia}, plant charges on both sides of the bridge pier.
As {p:Jason}, snipe the cargo ship's deck from the helicopter, then land.
Follow {p:Rocco} across the ship and plant explosives on the containers he finds.
Hold the deck until the helicopter returns, board it and blow up the ship.
As {p:Lucia}, raise the bridge, then dive in with {p:Vinny}, rig the Coast Guard boat and drill into the tunnel.
Sneak through the Coast Guard offices, open the garage shutter and defend the cargo while it is dragged out.
Hook the winch to the cargo and ride the net out, holding off pursuers with the {i:grenade launcher}.

summary.en: A single scene at {p:Abe}'s office, after which free roam opens up again.

unlock.en: Starts the first time you leave the penthouse after {i:Operation Savage Glory}.

text.en: Leave the penthouse after {i:Operation Savage Glory}.
Go to {p:Abe}'s office in {l:Downtown}.
Watch the meeting; free roam is open again when you leave.

summary.en: The last free-roam window before the finale: wrap up what you want, then pay {p:Abe}'s fee when you are ready.

missableNote.en: This is the point of no return for Chapter 5: once the fee is paid and you confirm at Abe's office, the last two missions run back to back. After the credits the game puts you back at the point before the finale, so free roam is not lost.

unlock.en: Starts after {i:Honest Abe}.

text.en: Use the reopened map to finish any side content you still want.
Make sure you can cover {p:Abe}'s $150,000 fee.
Pay the fee through {i:BuckMe} and go to {p:Abe}'s office when you are ready for the finale.

tips.en: Make a manual save in a spare slot before going on, because missions cannot be replayed.
Family Savings is one of the things that shapes the ending, so check that balance before you commit.

summary.en: A short phone task: send the $150,000 fee to the law firm to set the finale in motion.

unlock.en: Appears after {i:Honest Abe}.

text.en: Open the {i:BuckMe} app on your phone.
Send $150,000 to the law firm.
Head to {p:Abe}'s office to start the finale.

tips.en: The payment is needed to trigger the ending, so hold off until you have finished everything else you want to do.

summary.en: The first half of the finale. Once you confirm at {p:Abe}'s office, the story runs through to the end without a break.

missableNote.en: Once started, this mission and the final one play back to back. The single autosave is overwritten after each mission and missions cannot be replayed, so keep a manual save from before Abe's office.

unlock.en: Needs the $150,000 fee paid; a confirmation prompt at {p:Abe}'s office lets you postpone.

text.en: Confirm at {p:Abe}'s office in {l:Downtown} that you want to finish the story, then go to the penthouse.
As {p:Lucia}, sink the 8-ball by banking the cue ball off three cushions.
As {p:Jason}, leave the payment at the marked bench in {l:Panos Plaza} and return to {p:Dardan}.
As {p:Lucia}, get out of the police transport and escape the ambush.
As {p:Jason}, break out of the precinct, arm up at the armory and hold off the attackers.
Fight down the alley to the warehouse and survive the NOOSE assault.
As {p:Lucia}, cross {l:Hamlet} to the warehouse while avoiding patrol cars.
Defeat {p:Méndez}'s task force, then decide whether to shoot him or take his deal.

tips.en: Keep a manual save from before {p:Abe}'s office; the autosave is overwritten after each mission.
The decision at the very end of this mission is one of the things that shapes the ending.

summary.en: The final story mission, which ends with one last choice.

missableNote.en: Missions cannot be replayed, but after the credits the game returns you to the point before the last two missions, so the finale can be played again for a different ending.

unlock.en: Follows {i:Protective Custody} directly.

text.en: Choose your weapons at the hangar in the {l:Keys} and head out.
As {p:Lucia}, work the helicopter's mounted gun during the attack on the penthouse tower.
Fight to {p:Giorgio}'s office and plug in {p:Cal}'s equipment.
Cover {p:Jason} from the helicopter while he goes back for the {i:hard drive}.
As {p:Lucia}, jump across into the penthouse.
As {p:Jason}, reach the garage and pull {p:Lucia} out of the rubble.
Escape by car and destroy the helicopter chasing you.
Drive south toward {l:Fleming Key} and make the final choice at the bridge roadblock.

tips.en: The story closes with a two-way choice at the bridge roadblock, but that one decision does not settle everything: earlier play counts too.
What feeds into the ending: the relationship between {p:Jason} and {p:Lucia}, each character's Criminal Profile, your Family Savings and the decision made at the end of {i:Protective Custody}.
After the credits you are put back before the last two missions, so you can replay the finale and see another ending.

summary.en: 14 Top Fun locations with 3 time trials each. Beat the par time on the first two to open the third; the third only has to be finished. Winning one race at every location unlocks the trophy Top Fun. Dalton Island can only be reached by boat or aircraft. For the game's 100%: 42 of 42.
Six race organisers. Each location has 2 or more races, opened one after another; entry and rental fees apply. 20 wins unlock the trophy Earn Cash, Not Kudos. For the game's 100%: 30 of 40 won.
Solo time or score trials with bronze, silver and gold medals. For the game's 100%: 10 of 13 gold medals.
Two ranges with 6 challenges each. A $5 waiver pass is bought at each range; weapons can be rented. All golds unlock the trophy The Shootist. For the game's 100%: 42 of 42 gold medals.
Starting each game once is enough for 100%; finishing one unlocks the trophy Stick Fiddler. The three home games cannot be played during Chapter 2. For the game's 100%: 4 of 4 played.

Bars where an opponent waits at the pool table. There are 17 pool tables in total but only these 7 have opponents. Delights is closed for part of the story and reopens later. For the game's 100%: 5 of 7 defeated.
3 mini golf courses and 2 full golf courses. Only mini golf is on the 100% list. For the game's 100%: 2 of 3 mini golf locations played.
Score once at each hoop with the ball found beside it. For the game's 100%: 90 of 100.

Cal's bet Catch a Bigger Fish gives the trophy Baited My Tackle. One of the nine activity types for Master of None. For the game's 100%: Not on the checklist by itself (fish count as animals studied; a challenge asks for every species).

Bret Vogel (Lummox County, Jason only, after Veteran Hunted in Chapter 2) gives 15 hunting contracts. 61 huntable animal entries exist, 8 of them unique animals (a challenge asks for all 8). Meeting Bret also gives the hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69. For the game's 100%: 15 of 15 Target Decks.

8 categories of 10: Combat, Criminal, Exploration, Fitness, Shopping, Sports, Survival, Vehicle. All available from the start; tracked under Progress > Challenges. 50 unlock the trophy One Last Thing. For the game's 100%: 70 of 80.
Working out raises Strength; both characters at maximum gives the trophy Personal Best. For the game's 100%: No (a Fitness challenge asks for a membership).
The nine activity types the trophy tracker counts; do each once.

Hideouts of 9 gangs, shown as yellow Robbery Opportunity icons until visited. An operation counts once every key valuable (unique weapon, luxury watch, safe cash) is taken. They respawn after a long wait. Robbing one per gang unlocks the trophy Pest Control. For the game's 100%: 39 of 39 cleared.

14 small banks (cash drawer and safe) open after the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, which gives the Dye Pack Jammer. 8 large banks add a vault that is entered by following a security van; they open after the optional mission That's Where the Money Is… at the end of Chapter 4. Brands: Fleeca 8, Shorefront 6, Lombank 6, independents 2 (Gibson Brothers Bank, Druthers State Bank). Robbing 5 vaults unlocks Maximum Withdrawal. For the game's 100%: 22 of 22 fully completed, and 8 of 8 vaults hit.
Open after the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check. Six are in Vice-Dale County, one (Cash Flow) in Kelly County. They pay in marked bills. For the game's 100%: 7 of 7 fully completed.

Jewelry stores (20, open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3) and pawn shops (15, open after Coffee Break in Chapter 2). Loot the back-room safe as well as the display cases. region is the county (vice-city stands for Vice-Dale County). For the game's 100%: 34 of 35 fully completed.
Every shop known to allow a stick-up: convenience stores, liquor stores and fast food places. For the game's 100%: 50 of 91 fully completed.

Fences are green map icons with initials; each pays a different rate for narcotics, jewelry and marked bills, and the line-up changes with the story. From Chapter 3 goods can be dropped in your own garage and sent to a chosen fence. For the game's 100%: Narcotics $100,000; Jewelry $100,000; Marked Bills $250,000; Vehicles $200,000.
Drug labs destroyed for Tyrone (Jason) after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty; each pays $2,000 to $2,500 and enough of them open the final job Spin On This. Not missable.

Moses wants 6 vehicles (Chapter 2, Port Gellhorn; reward is his unique Sultan). Randy's Wish List has 16 cars (Chapter 3, Balsero), followed by Dale Mamba and Mansion Thrax; finishing gives the Tempesta and the Domestic Timbers garage. For the game's 100%: Sales count toward Vehicles Fenced.
